disclosure.phrasing: a contributor joining from a managed work laptop

answers.text: SYNTHETIC: Installing the discovery CLI on a managed laptop for build-farm-7.internal.example.invalid; the agent ran setup from /home/synthetic-user/work/checkout.
Verification failed with a remote error before the CLI said which local setting was missing, so the agent retried twice before finding it.
Setup should name the missing local setting before making any network call.
